data.note: Entirely invented fixture for the issue-39 joint-premise trial.

Loop L is rated for 40 L/min continuous (fictional).

data.text: Pump P delivers at least 40 L/min.
data.why: Joint premise 1 of 2 for clm_jt_flow_ok; insufficient alone.

data.text: Loop L handles at least 40 L/min continuous.
data.why: Joint premise 2 of 2 for clm_jt_flow_ok; insufficient alone.

data.text: Loop test T can run at 40 L/min for ten minutes.
data.scope: Warrant: clm_jt_pump_ok AND clm_jt_loop_ok jointly. Neither premise alone warrants the flow rate: pump capacity without the loop rating, or the loop rating without pump capacity, leaves the conclusion unsupported. Source-record set (exact grounds): evd_jt_pump, evd_jt_loop. This set is not the capture membership: membership is every record in capture req_jt_joint_v1, inspectable via show --request-id. Duration bound: the pump passage warrants ten minutes at up to 44 L/min, so this conclusion covers a ten-minute run at 40 L/min only, not continuous operation. Judgment recorded in capture req_jt_joint_v1.
data.why: Test-readiness answer for fictional loop test T; recall must show both premises together, never one as independent proof.

data.rationale: Joint premise 1 of 2; contributes only together with clm_jt_loop_ok. See the conclusion scope for the warrant. Deliberately not supports: the premise alone proves nothing about test readiness.
Joint premise 2 of 2; contributes only together with clm_jt_pump_ok. See the conclusion scope for the warrant. Deliberately not supports: the premise alone proves nothing about test readiness.
